(Mu) Fine Sniper Rifle.name: (Mu) Fine Sniper Rifle
(Mu) Fine Sniper Rifle.description: A full-bore auto-lock with customized trigger, double cartridge, thorough gauge. It can fire mystic ammunition.

(Mu) Mystic Ammunition.name: (Mu) Mystic Ammunition
(Mu) Mystic Ammunition.description: A large-caliber shell, designed to be fired from a specialized gun that releases mystic energies when it hits. Grants potency against mystic targets.

(S) Spacesuit.name: (S) Spacesuit
(S) Spacesuit.description: Some radiation protection, survival in toxic atmospheres, EVA. Half a day of oxygen (or other gas, liquid, or substance you breathe).

(N) Stun Blasters.name: (N) Stun Blasters
(N) Stun Blasters.description: Regular blasters with bonus stun settings, for when your important VIP won't cooperate

(Sp) Small Luxury Item.name: (Sp) Small Luxury Item
(Sp) Small Luxury Item.description: Fine brandies, small but thoughtful gifts, spices and perfumes, fine instruments, popular games, etc. These can come in varied sizes. Each time you bring one of these on the job, explain what it is and why it's luxurious.

(Mu) Fine Vibro-Blade.name: (Mu) Fine Vibro-Blade
(Mu) Fine Vibro-Blade.description: Cuts through almost any material. Decorated. Knife or dueling blade.

(Me) Vision-Enhancing Goggles.name: (Me) Vision-Enhancing Goggles
(Me) Vision-Enhancing Goggles.description: Eyewear with settings for thermal and ultraviolet, and magnification levels in the thousands. Even tints when required.

(S) Repair Tools.name: (S) Repair Tools
(S) Repair Tools.description: Things you need to fix ship engines, speeders, hovercars, and the like. Tools to hot-splice consoles and tweak machinery. Hammers, a welder, screwdrivers, wrenches, battery chargers, spray-painters.

(Sp) Fine Clothes.name: (Sp) Fine Clothes
(Sp) Fine Clothes.description: Silk sarongs, suits, fine blue capes. You stand out and are always dressed for the occasion. Nobody will mistake these for a disguise.

(My) Precursor Artifact.name: (My) Precursor Artifact
(My) Precursor Artifact.description: A small object made of ancient materials. Precursor tech.

(My) Offerings.name: (My) Offerings
(My) Offerings.description: A candle, oil lamp, flowers, food, water, incense, pebbles from your journey.

(Sp) Memento Of a Past Encounter.name: (Sp) Memento Of a Past Encounter
(Sp) Memento Of a Past Encounter.description: A distinctive piece of jewelry, a fine blade with a House crest, a signet ring, a small statue.

(Sc) Mystic Ammunition.name: (Sc) Mystic Ammunition
(Sc) Mystic Ammunition.description: A large-caliber shell, designed to be fired from a specialized gun, which releases mystic energies when it hits. Grants potency against mystic targets.

(N) Knockout Drugs.name: (N) Knockout Drugs
(N) Knockout Drugs.description: Side effects are common and may include headache, nausea, dizziness, sudden death, violent fits of rage, and/or mild discomfort.  May not work on all Xenos.

(S) Illicit Drugs.name: (S) Illicit Drugs
(S) Illicit Drugs.description: What's your poison, space cowboy? For personal use, catching a dangerous bounty, or entertainment while traveling between planets.

(Me) Fine Hacking Rig.name: (Me) Fine Hacking Rig
(Me) Fine Hacking Rig.description: Visualization goggles, unpublished exploits, overclocked non-market chips, optical vampire taps. Hacking is as much about hardware as it is about software.

(My) Fine Melee Weapon.name: (My) Fine Melee Weapon
(My) Fine Melee Weapon.description: Antiquated weapon that acts as an extension of your body. In the age of blasters, swords and polearms are quaint remnants of culture and custom for the most part. But Way powers seem to interact stubbornly with advanced technology. Each mystic order keeps anachronistic items, and uses them in different ways.

(S) Medkit.name: (S) Medkit
(S) Medkit.description: Blood for a few common races, gauze, antiradiation injector, laser scalpel, antiseptics, thread, painkillers.

(P) Fine Small Urbot.name: (P) Fine Small Urbot
(P) Fine Small Urbot.description: A small Urbot that supports piloting and can carry a few items. Seems eerily sentient.

(St) Fine Bedside Manner.name: (St) Fine Bedside Manner
(St) Fine Bedside Manner.description: Charm that sets patients at ease. Some Stitches never bother to bring this.

(My) Memento Of Your Travels.name: (My) Memento Of Your Travels
(My) Memento Of Your Travels.description: A small statue, outdated currency, a lock of hair, a picture.

(St) Fine Clothing.name: (St) Fine Clothing
(St) Fine Clothing.description: A suit or outfit for fancy dinner parties and high society.

(St) Fine Medkit.name: (St) Fine Medkit
(St) Fine Medkit.description: Better stocked than the standard. Skin staples, diagnostic hand scanners, synthflesh, bone stabilizers, spray hypos, antivenom (for dangerous alien beasts), and a wider selection of drugs.

(St) Recognizable Medic Garb.name: (St) Recognizable Medic Garb
(St) Recognizable Medic Garb.description: The common red medic outfit bearing the official white medic seal of the Hegemony. Recognizable from a distance.

(Mu) Fine Martial Arts Style.name: (Mu) Fine Martial Arts Style
(Mu) Fine Martial Arts Style.description: Your own custom blend of combat techniques, unique as a fingerprint.

(P) Fine Mechanic's Kit.name: (P) Fine Mechanic's Kit
(P) Fine Mechanic's Kit.description: Hand-held scanners, hull patch kit, assortment of hand tools. Everything you need to patch a vehicle and get it flying again.

(S) Hacking Tools.name: (S) Hacking Tools
(S) Hacking Tools.description: Deck, splicing pliers, plugs and ports, keypad crackers, specialized software, custom-modified chips, rainbow dictionaries, automated exploits. What every growing hacker needs.

(My) Outdated Religious Outfit.name: (My) Outdated Religious Outfit
(My) Outdated Religious Outfit.description: Robes, worn cloaks, sandals, etc. Participants and practitioners of popular and sanctioned Hegemonic Cults often bear well-known insignia of modern manufacture.

(Me) Genius Pet.name: (Me) Genius Pet
(Me) Genius Pet.description: Incapable of speaking, but can understand language and assist with basic tasks. Likes you. Really cute. Anticipates your actions.

(Sc) Forged Documents.name: (Sc) Forged Documents
(Sc) Forged Documents.description: Reasonably well-made facsimiles of documents that would never actually be given to someone like you.

(Mu) Fine Blaster Pistol.name: (Mu) Fine Blaster Pistol
(Mu) Fine Blaster Pistol.description: As a friend or ally, this signature pistol can be used during downtime to threaten or intimidate. As an enemy, someone else owns it and it's carrying a bullet for you.

(S) Detonator.name: (S) Detonator
(S) Detonator.description: Extremely deadly explosive weapon. Fits in the palm of your hand and can be thrown. Takes care of those shielded doors that heavy blasters can't handle. llegal. You shouldn't have this. No, really.

(Me) Spare Parts.name: (Me) Spare Parts
(Me) Spare Parts.description: Usually for ship repairs and electronics. Often forgotten in a pocket or tool belt. Although it's usually nothing overly expensive, you end up carrying parts you're working on and pieces for fixing ships. If you ever need a wire, solder, or a piece of tape, you have it on hand. Anything rare or more complex might take a lifestyle roll to have on you.

(Sc) Fine Coat.name: (Sc) Fine Coat
(Sc) Fine Coat.description: A heavy but well-made and well-kept coat. Distinctive and with a history.

(Sp) Medium Luxury Item.name: (Sp) Medium Luxury Item
(Sp) Medium Luxury Item.description: Fine brandies, small but thoughtful gifts, spices and perfumes, fine instruments, popular games, etc. These can come in varied sizes. Each time you bring one of these on the job, explain what it is and why it's luxurious.

(Sc) Personal Memento.name: (Sc) Personal Memento
(Sc) Personal Memento.description: A keepsake you cherish. A locket, small holo, music from your homeworld.

(Sp) Large Luxury Item.name: (Sp) Large Luxury Item
(Sp) Large Luxury Item.description: Fine brandies, small but thoughtful gifts, spices and perfumes, fine instruments, popular games, etc. These can come in varied sizes. Each time you bring one of these on the job, explain what it is and why it's luxurious.

(P) Fine Customized Spacesuit.name: (P) Fine Customized Spacesuit
(P) Fine Customized Spacesuit.description: Sweet decals, emergency beacon, some thrust. Will keep you alive in space or when your cockpit gets shot. Lets you move about a bit and maybe even extends jumps in atmosphere.

(S) Spy Gear.name: (S) Spy Gear
(S) Spy Gear.description: Disguises, voice modulators, mini-cameras, thermal scanners, false thumbprints, and audio filters.

(St) Syringes and Applicators.name: (St) Syringes and Applicators
(St) Syringes and Applicators.description: Syringes, injectors, patch applicators. Many can be palmed easily. Sometimes having drugs on hand also means having to subtly administer them.

(Mu) Fine Flamethrower.name: (Mu) Fine Flamethrower
(Mu) Fine Flamethrower.description: For those times when you really need to heat things up. Settings for regular and extra crispy. Not easy to hide. Attacks cover the area of a small room (and leave distinct scorch marks that may result in additional Heat ). Complications when getting shot may include the fuel tanks rupturing.

(My) Trappings Of Religion.name: (My) Trappings Of Religion
(My) Trappings Of Religion.description: Scrolls, texts, icons, cups and bowls, bells.

(Sp) Legitimate ID.name: (Sp) Legitimate ID
(Sp) Legitimate ID.description: A properly encoded Hegemonic ID indicating your legitimate station in the Hegemony.

(P) Victory Cigars.name: (P) Victory Cigars
(P) Victory Cigars.description: Enough to share with a few choice people. What's the point of pulling off amazing stunts if you can't celebrate? No guarantee the rest of your crew will appreciate the smell, or won't turn up the air filters.

(Sc) Loaded Dice or Trick Holo-cards.name: (Sc) Loaded Dice or Trick Holo-cards
(Sc) Loaded Dice or Trick Holo-cards.description: Gambling accoutrements subtly altered to favor particular outcomes. Luck is one of your many skills. Sometimes it just needs a little help though.

(S) Blaster Pistol.name: (S) Blaster Pistol
(S) Blaster Pistol.description: Shoots bolts of hot plasma. Accurate only at close range. Makes "pew pew" noises (mandatory). Comes in a variety of shapes.

(Me) Fine Ship Repair Tools.name: (Me) Fine Ship Repair Tools
(Me) Fine Ship Repair Tools.description: Power-assisted wrenches, a sonic drill, testing probes, power calibrators, a rivet gun.

(Sc) Fine Blaster Pistol.name: (Sc) Fine Blaster Pistol
(Sc) Fine Blaster Pistol.description: Customized or strange. Can fire mystic ammunition.

(S) Melee Weapon.name: (S) Melee Weapon
(S) Melee Weapon.description: Sharp. Blunt. Pointy. Stabby. Slicy. All different sizes. Some come with laser edges. Some vibrate...ooh. Batteries included.

(Me) Small Drone.name: (Me) Small Drone
(Me) Small Drone.description: Small, remote-controlled drone with cameras. May be able to carry something light.

(P) Grappling Hook.name: (P) Grappling Hook
(P) Grappling Hook.description: Small, but mechanized. Can pull you up. Fits in your belt. Makes you look dashing when you swing to the rescue.

(Mu) Detonator Launcher.name: (Mu) Detonator Launcher
(Mu) Detonator Launcher.description: Fires detonators at high velocity. Detonators are illegal, so this generates Heat when fired. Can be used to target/damage vehicles and structures. Not subtle. Batteries included, but detonators marked separately.

(S) Communicator.name: (S) Communicator
(S) Communicator.description: Has a few bands, likely even a few encrypted. Works only when within orbit.

(S) Heavy Blaster.name: (S) Heavy Blaster
(S) Heavy Blaster.description: Can do some considerable damage to vehicles and things like unshielded doors. Has about a dozen shots. Will do serious and messy harm to people. Illegal.

(N) Restraints.name: (N) Restraints
(N) Restraints.description: A wide variety to handle all manner of Xenos

(P) Guild License.name: (P) Guild License
(P) Guild License.description: Legit pilot certification (though it may not be yours). Will allow you passage through a jumpgate.

(S) Armor.name: (S) Armor
(S) Armor.description: Really unsubtle, full body stuff. Stops a few bolts. Will shrug off a knife without noticing. Powered. Assists in movement.
